# Abiding in the Shepherd's Care

## John 10:27

"I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand." (John 10:28, NIV)

## Reflection

In the midst of life's chaos, it's easy to feel like we're being pulled in a hundred different directions. Our minds are constantly racing, and our hearts are filled with worry and anxiety. But as followers of Christ, we have a promise that stands firm above all else: we are forever in His care. The Shepherd of our souls will not let us go, no matter what challenges we face. He has given us eternal life, and His grip is unshakeable. We can rest in the knowledge that we are safe, not because of our own strength or abilities, but because of His unrelenting love for us. Let us learn to trust in His goodness and sovereignty, even when the world around us seems uncertain. Let us abide in the Shepherd's care, and find peace in His presence.

## Prayer

We thank you, Lord, for your promise of eternal life and your unshakeable grip on our souls. Help us to rest in your care and trust in your goodness, even when the world around us seems uncertain.

## One-Line Application

We can rest in the Shepherd's care, trusting His unrelenting love and sovereignty.
